headline: MU up about 3% pre-market after Monday's 5.8% drop; AMD reports tonight
tldr: Monday's chip bounce failed, MU closed at $833.59 (−5.78%) and Seoul and Taipei each fell 3.6% overnight. MU is still indicated about 2–3% higher near $850–$860 on a flat-to-firm Nasdaq, but tonight's AMD, Arista and Super Micro results and the election make this open easy to fade, as Monday's was.

headline: MU indicated about 2% higher as chips bounce despite Kioxia
tldr: Futures are up after Friday's chip rout, helped by Korea's strong chip exports, SK Hynix's 3.8% gain and lower oil, so MU is set to open about 2–3% higher near $905, with Kioxia's flat NAND outlook as the main risk.

headline: Kioxia's weak outlook hits memory after Friday's chip sell-off
tldr: US markets are closed today (Sunday) and reopen Monday at 9:30 ET (8:30 SK). Futures are up modestly after Friday's sell-off in chips, SK Hynix has recovered in Seoul, and Kioxia's flat profit outlook is the main new risk for memory stocks.
